title: Event System
summary: This module provides a robust event bus for CrewAI, enabling event-driven architecture with synchronous and asynchronous handler management, dependency resolution, and event recording for tracing and state management.

nodes.label: BaseEvent
nodes.title: Base Event Class
nodes.description: The foundational class for all events within the CrewAI system, defining common attributes like timestamp, type, source, and unique identifiers.

nodes.label: CrewAIEventsBus
nodes.title: CrewAI Event Bus
nodes.description: A singleton event bus responsible for registering, emitting, and managing event handlers. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous processing with dependency resolution.

nodes.label: Event Context Management
nodes.title: Event Context Management
nodes.description: Provides utilities for managing event scopes and parent-child relationships between events, crucial for tracing and structured event logging.

nodes.label: A2A Event Types
nodes.title: A2A Specific Event Types
nodes.description: Defines various event types specifically for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, covering notifications, agent card fetching, delegation, and context lifecycle.

nodes.label: Checkpoint Listener
nodes.title: Checkpoint Listener
nodes.description: A listener that triggers checkpointing based on specific events, ensuring system state is saved at critical junctures.

nodes.label: EventRecord
nodes.title: Event Record
nodes.description: A directed graph-like structure that stores and manages all emitted events, allowing for O(1) lookup and traversal of event relationships.

nodes.label: Tracing Utilities
nodes.title: Tracing Utilities
nodes.description: Provides utility functions related to tracing, such as confirming tracing enablement on first execution.

groups.label: Event Core
groups.title: Core Event Handling
groups.description: Components central to defining, emitting, and managing events within the system.

groups.label: Event Types
groups.title: Specific Event Definitions
groups.description: Definitions for various specialized event types, particularly those related to Agent-to-Agent communication.

groups.label: Event Persistence & State
groups.title: Event Persistence and State Management
groups.description: Components responsible for recording events and managing system state based on event occurrences.

groups.label: Event Utilities
groups.title: Event-Related Utilities
groups.description: Helper functions and utilities that support the event system's functionality, such as tracing.
